CONCEPT STUDY
01
Mobile App · FinTech & Debt Settlement
TripSplit
.
Effortless, privacy-first group expense sharing and optimal debt settlement for Android.
THE PROBLEM WE EXPLORED
Most group expense apps force participants through tedious account registration and break without cellular coverage. TripSplit explores frictionless deep-link claiming, offline Room SQLite persistence, and bidirectional Firestore sync.
ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS
Dynamic Android App Links allowing instant expedition join without mandatory credentials
First-claim cryptographic link burning in Firestore to prevent invite interception
Graph-theoretic settlement algorithm reducing n-way debts into the absolute minimum transactions
Local Room database cache ensuring 100% offline creation, calculation, and balance viewing
KEY TAKEAWAY
Consumer utility apps win on friction elimination: zero-signup joining and zero-latency offline operation.
Discuss a project like this
View all capabilities
HOW WE EVALUATE EVERY BUILD
Engineered with architectural discipline.
Whether building an MVP or a mission-critical platform, we hold our code to four consistent standards.
Performance-Minded Builds
Lean bundle sizes, responsive image delivery, server-rendered components, and snappy client interactions.
End-to-End Type Safety
Strict TypeScript from database schemas to client components, catching regressions at compile time.
Ergonomics & Accessibility
Targeting WCAG 2.2 AA standards, touch-friendly 44px+ hit targets, clear keyboard focus indicators, and reduced-motion care.
Full Code Handover
Clean repository structure, comprehensive documentation, and complete ownership of custom project deliverables governed by the client agreement.
FLEXIBLE, SPRINT-BASED ENGAGEMENT
Have an idea you want to make real?
From an initial architecture sprint to a focused MVP launch, we tailor our process around your specific timeline and scope with clear milestones and direct collaboration.

title: Privacy Policy — AWSAVYA
main_text:
TRANSPARENT & MINIMAL
Privacy notice.
Clear and straightforward.
We practice intentional data minimization. We only collect the information necessary to understand your project and respond to your enquiry.
LAST UPDATED: OCTOBER 2026
TRANSPARENT PRACTICES
TABLE OF CONTENTS
1. Overview
2. Information We Collect
3. How Information Is Used
4. Cookies & Analytics
5. Email Delivery & Security
6. Retention & Your Choices
7. Privacy Contact
We never sell or broker your contact details.
01
Overview
AWSAVYA operates this website as an architectural showcase and project enquiry channel. Our approach is grounded in simplicity:
No advertising trackers or cross-site behavioral pixels
No data brokering, renting, or automated user profiling
Strict purpose limitation: responding to your project enquiry
Right to request correction or removal of your details anytime
02
Information We Collect
We only receive personal details that you voluntarily submit through our contact form or send directly by email:
Your name:
To address you in direct conversation.
Work email address:
To reply to your project enquiry.
Company or organization name (optional):
To understand your business context.
Project details and requirements:
To evaluate scope, technical architecture, and timelines.
We do not collect sensitive categories of data such as payment card details, government identification, or precise location coordinates.
03
How Information Is Used
Your details are used solely for genuine communication regarding the enquiry or project you initiated:
To review technical requirements and provide indicative architecture, milestones, or estimates.
To send follow-up correspondence directly related to your project conversation.
We do not add your contact information to unprompted marketing newsletters without explicit consent.
04
Cookies & Technical Logging
This website does not embed third-party advertising cookies, cross-site analytics trackers, or social tracking pixels.
Like most web services, our hosting provider may generate standard technical access logs (including request method, timestamp, user agent, and IP address) for basic operational security, DDoS mitigation, and diagnostic rate-limiting.
05
Form Delivery & Encryption
Form submissions are transmitted to our server endpoints over encrypted connections (HTTPS).
When form delivery is active, messages are routed server-side through our form-delivery processor (Web3Forms) directly to our studio inbox. Server-side secrets and access keys are never exposed in client bundles.
06
Data Retention & Your Choices
We keep enquiry correspondence only as long as needed to discuss your project or maintain an active business relationship. If an enquiry does not lead to an engagement, correspondence is kept only as long as needed to respond.
Access
You may request a copy of the communication records associated with your email address.
Correction
You may request updates or corrections to any outdated or inaccurate details.
Deletion
You may request that your contact details and message history be permanently deleted.
Communication Pause
You may ask us to discontinue project correspondence at any time.
07
Privacy Contact
If you have questions about our data practices or wish to request the deletion of your contact records, please reach out to us:
AWSAVYA Contact
Email:
hello@awsavya.in
